cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: an empty modern wave-training pool at a coastal sports laboratory — she guides a floating hoop across a gentle wave with both hands while standing in the shallow lane; a Roman marble bath hall — plays a guzheng zither laid across her lap or a low table; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a modern community rehearsal hall after a dance class — she rewinds a rehearsal cassette by turning its spool with a pencil; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — standing; a Guan Yu temple — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a present-day miniature puppet-theatre repair studio — she carefully untangles two puppet-control rings from an overhead hook; a convention photo zone under ring lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a Yangtze ferry landing with moored junks under red sails and coiled ropes on the wooden pier — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; an airport lounge — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — holds a small hand lantern low at her side
